summary: Master the complexities of financial markets with our Advanced Training Course. Enhance your knowledge of instruments and strategies for successful investing.
lede: Financial instruments training explains how markets and instruments affect funding, investment and risk decisions. For treasury and finance managers, investment analysts and risk professionals, the course builds practical skills in comparing cash and bond options, assessing FX and interest-rate exposure, and evaluating hedging choices. Case exercises also help participants interpret yield curves and spreads and review instrument terms when making funding, investment and liquidity decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly interact with financial markets, instruments, or market-driven decisions.
audience: Investment and portfolio analysts in banks, asset
Relationship managers and product specialists in financial
CFO office staff and business unit leaders
modules: Money Markets and Short Term Instruments
Fixed Income Securities and Yield Curves
Equity Markets and Value Creation Signals
Derivatives Fundamentals: Forwards, Futures and Swaps
Market Risk, Liquidity Risk and Hedging Strategies
Integrating Markets and Instruments into Funding and Investment Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial concepts and basic exposure to market operations. Prior experience in finance-related roles is recommended but not mandatory.
